operation.summary: Make a one-time link code for this Bridgit as the target (8 characters, 10 minutes, 5 wrong tries); needs a Device Domain Name; explicit owner.configuration grant required; no per-change phone approval

body.name: services
body.description: What the claiming Bridgit may use here: camera, gallery, interactions, location, mic, sounds, speaker, view (suggested: camera, mic, speaker, interactions, view); required for in

body.name: directions
body.description: ["in"] (default: the claiming Bridgit uses this one), ["out"] (this one uses it) or both

body.name: agents
body.description: For out: this Bridgit's control agent ids that may use the claiming Bridgit

body.name: tier
body.description: own (default: the owner's own device), associate (a named person's device: services interactions, sounds, speaker, view, ends or is reviewed) or public (a device in the wild: one of interactions, view, in only, at most 24 h, the owner allows each change)

body.name: access_ms
body.description: associate and public: how long the claimed link's access lasts (associate 1 min-90 days, default 30 days; public 1 min-24 h, default 1 h)

body.name: associate_email
body.description: associate: the person's email (required; their Bridgit confirms the link from that account)

operation.returns: code_id, code (K7QX-3MPA: give it with the name), name, expires_at, tier, tier_about, access_ms, associate, services, directions, link (bridgit://link#… for a QR code), name_lookup, how

directions.description: ["in"] (default: the claiming Bridgit uses this one), ["out"] (this one uses it) or both

tier.description: own (default: the owner's own device), associate (a named person's device: services interactions, sounds, speaker, view, ends or is reviewed) or public (a device in the wild: one of interactions, view, in only, at most 24 h, the owner allows each change)

associate_email.description: associate: the person's email (required; their Bridgit confirms the link from that account)

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice

access_ms.description: associate and public: how long the claimed link's access lasts (associate 1 min-90 days, default 30 days; public 1 min-24 h, default 1 h)
